summary_en: This study tests cladribine given with rituximab in adults with hairy cell leukemia, including cases that have come back. Cladribine is given through a vein over 2 hours on days 1 to 5, and rituximab is given through a vein once a week for 8 weeks, starting on day 28, unless the disease gets worse or side effects are unacceptable. This is a Phase II study, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba cladribina combinada con rituximab en adultos con leucemia de células pilosas, incluidos los casos que han recaído. La cladribina se administra por vena durante 2 horas los días 1 al 5, y el rituximab se administra por vena una vez por semana durante 8 semanas, a partir del día 28, a menos que la enfermedad empeore o los efectos secundarios sean inaceptables. Es un estudio de fase II, y la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Hairy cell leukemia confirmed by bone marrow exam
Relapsed disease allowed if no more than one prior therapy
Women who could become pregnant must use birth control during the study
Performance status of 3 or less, with kidney, liver and bilirubin limits
not_for: Known HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Cancer spread to the brain or central nervous system
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart disease
